Đánh giá
Basic to Rapid Temperature Cycling
CSZ's Z-Plus Test Chambers are capable of simulating a variety of temperature and humidity conditions for environmental testing. Z-Plus chambers are available in a variety of sizes and performance packages with over 150 models to choose from and may be used for basic thermal cycling to accelerated stress testing. Sizes range from 8 cu. ft. (227L) to 96 cu. ft. (2718L). These chambers are designed for ease-of-use, reliability and performance and include many user-friendly features standard with your purchase for the best value in the industry.
The EZT-570S Touch Screen Controller includes a 7” (18 cm) or optional 10” (25 cm) touch screen and the latest in test chamber programming for ease of use. With CSZ EZT-570S controller, users can program, trend chart, datalog, and download their files. Other features are included such as product control, remote control from PC or wireless device, receive email/text message alarms and more.
We continue to focus on delivering the best test chamber in the industry and have made several enhancements. See our list of recent updates to our Z-Plus test chambers.

 Tundra®: -45°C to +190°C (-50°F to +375°F)
 Cascade: -70°C to +190°C (-94°F to +375°F)
Optional Humidity Range
10% to 98% RH
 5% to 98% RH (optional)
